Name: Lamech, Son of Methusael
Summary: Lamech was the son of Methusael, a descendant of Cain, and the first man recorded as having two wives, Adah and Zillah.
KeyStory: Lamech boasted to his wives about killing a man in revenge, showing how violence deepened in Cain's line.
RelatedPeople: Methusael; Adah, Wife of Lamech; Zillah; Jabal; Jubal; Tubal-cain; Naamah
LifeLesson: Lamech's boast shows where unchecked vengeance leads: further from God, not closer.
